children: By Naveen Thukral and Ella Cao

A Chinese private crusher has purchased one Panamax cargo, or around 68,000 metric tons, of Australian canola for March shipment, two sources told Reuters, in one of the first new-crop deals by a private buyer since Beijing broadened import access in July to include private crushers.
